lesson: Conflicts between the architecture and the framing rule surface in the layout computation; they are design decisions, not things to fix silently.
rule: Report every opening whose rough opening plus header doesn't fit under the plates as a decision for the user; never move a header into the top plates. Size each header from the span tables for its opening and the load it carries (bearing wall under rafters vs non-bearing); never default to the stud size. Splitting a long opening into standard units with posts turns an engineered beam into table-sized headers.
validation: Rough opening and header heights dimensioned on the shop drawing
Header size per opening reported with its span and bearing condition
